title: Project switcher
responsibility: Lets a person switch between listed projects or open another local project.

inputs.name: ProjectSwitcher.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace store instance (type Workspace, a WorkspaceState class instance) whose projectId, projects, snapshot, busy, bridge and local the switcher reads and whose switchProject(projectId) and openProject() it calls. The select resets to workspace.projectId only after switchProject resolves, so a rejected switch skips that reset.

outputs.name: ProjectSwitcher
outputs.description: The switcher bar holds a ChoiceDialog labelled 'Choose workbench' with a workbench icon, disabled while workspace.busy, whose content is a 'Project' select of the projects (the shown project is appended when the bridge does not list it), grouped as 'On this device' or 'On your computer' for local projects and 'Shared' for shared ones, or a 'No projects yet' notice when there are none, followed by the shown project's name when one exists (cut with an ellipsis when long, with the full name as its title). Choosing a project closes the dialog, calls workspace.switchProject with the chosen id and resets the select to workspace.projectId once that resolves; the 'Add local project' button (shown only when workspace.bridge is set and workspace.local is true, disabled while workspace.busy) calls workspace.openProject(), a 'Loading project…' status shows while workspace.busy, and this component never displays workspace.error.

errors.name: Workspace operation failure
errors.description: Errors and rejected promises from workspace.switchProject (reached through choose, which the select's change handler calls) and from workspace.openProject (the Add button) are not caught by this component. Both handlers discard the returned promise with void, and a switchProject rejection ends choose before the select resets to workspace.projectId.
